name: Flashcards
description: Study your decks with Anki-style queues and FSRS scheduling. Use the keypad to grade each answer and resume your reviews later.
author: thooton

changes.text: The setup screen's title is readable (its own on_primary, day and night, instead of common's white on Anki's light bar).
An unreadable collection is set aside rather than saved over.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Set up on the phone, on this phone only or with a command center that syncs the decks; no login built in.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Show how much of a deck is learned, not just introduced.
Import's file list now has an Import title.
Reviews due on the same day come in a random order, as Anki's Due date, then random.
Anki-style pop-up menu and an OLED dark mode.
